description.en: Smart boat automation, anchor drift watch, and marine telemetry for OpenPlotter and Signal K.

hint.en: Triggers when the vessel drifts beyond the configured anchor swing radius.
Triggers with hysteresis when a battery bank's State of Charge drops below the selected threshold.
Triggers when Signal K navigation.state transitions (moored, anchored, motoring, sailing).
Triggers when a specific Signal K path receives a new telemetry value.
Triggers when shore power AC input connects or disconnects.

titleFormatted.en: Signal K notification raised for prefix [[pathPrefix]] with minimum severity [[minState]]

hint.en: Triggers when Signal K emits a notification alarm (alert, warn, alarm, or emergency).
Checks whether a Signal K notification path currently has an active alert, warn, alarm, or emergency state.
Checks whether the vessel's Anchor Drift Watch is currently armed.
Checks whether a battery bank's State of Charge (%) is below the specified threshold.
Checks the current Signal K navigation.state of the vessel.

title.en: Signal K path value satisfies comparison

hint.en: Compares the latest numeric value of a Signal K path against a threshold.

titleFormatted.en: Arm Anchor Watch with max radius [[max_radius]] m

hint.en: Drops anchor at the vessel's current GPS position and arms Anchor Drift Watch with the specified maximum swing radius.
Raises the anchor in Signal K and disarms Homey Anchor Drift Watch.

title.en: Publish custom path value to Signal K

titleFormatted.en: Publish value [[value]] to Signal K path [[path]]

hint.en: Publishes an arbitrary value to a Signal K dot-path via the WebSocket delta stream.

title.en: Publish cabin humidity (%) to Signal K

titleFormatted.en: Publish humidity [[humidity_pct]]% for zone [[zone]] to Signal K

hint.en: Converts relative humidity percentage (0..100%) to SI ratio (0..1) and publishes to environment.inside.<zone>.relativeHumidity.
Publishes or clears a Signal K notification alarm (normal, alert, warn, alarm, or emergency).

title.en: Publish barometric pressure (hPa) to Signal K

titleFormatted.en: Publish pressure [[pressure_hpa]] hPa for zone [[zone]] to Signal K

hint.en: Converts hPa/mbar to Pascals (Pa) and publishes to environment.inside.<zone>.pressure.

title.en: Publish switch or contact state to Signal K

titleFormatted.en: Publish state [[state]] to Signal K path [[path]]

hint.en: Publishes a Homey switch, relay, or hatch/door contact boolean state to Signal K.

title.en: Publish cabin temperature (°C) to Signal K

titleFormatted.en: Publish temperature [[temperature_c]]°C for zone [[zone]] to Signal K

hint.en: Converts Celsius to Kelvin and publishes to environment.inside.<zone>.temperature via Signal K delta stream.

title.en: Send PUT control command to Signal K path

titleFormatted.en: PUT value [[value]] to Signal K path [[path]]

hint.en: Sends an authenticated PUT command to a writable Signal K path (switches, chargers, inverters, anchor watch). Safety-critical steering, propulsion, and course paths are strictly blocked.

title.en: Set Anchor Watch maximum swing radius

titleFormatted.en: Set Anchor Watch max radius to [[max_radius]] m

hint.en: Updates the Anchor Drift Watch maximum swing radius in meters via Signal K PUT / anchor plugin.
Sets the operating mode on a Victron MultiPlus/Quattro inverter or shore charger for battery load shedding.
